report_timezones.settlement_flat_file_v2: UTC (dates written 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS UTC'; posted-date is the UTC date)
report_timezones.date_range_transaction_reports: America/Los_Angeles (PDT/PST suffix); each monthly file covers the Pacific calendar month

meta.month_rule: An amount belongs to the calendar month (America/Los_Angeles) of its posted date-time; deposits belong to the month the bank posted them; orders belong to the month of purchase-date in America/Los_Angeles.
meta.sign_convention: Seller's point of view as in the settlement file: money to the seller positive, fees/refunds/advertising negative; marketplace_facilitator_collected positive and _remitted negative (they net to zero); owed_by_amazon amounts are positive when Amazon holds seller money.

definitions.net_product_sales: product_sales + shipping_credits + gift_wrap_credits + promotional_rebates + refunds_product (all ex tax)
definitions.refunds_product: everything given back to buyers on Refund, A-to-z Guarantee and Chargeback lines except tax: principal, shipping, gift wrap, and the promotion amounts that come back (positive) on the refund
definitions.amazon_fees.referral: Commission on orders, Commission returned on refunds, RefundCommission (refund administration fee)
definitions.amazon_fees.storage: monthly FBA inventory storage fee and the aged-inventory (long-term) storage fee, by the month they are posted (each is for an earlier month)
definitions.amazon_fees.other: ShippingChargeback and GiftwrapChargeback (and their reversals), subscription fee, FBA removal/disposal fees, FBA inbound placement service fees, coupon participation and performance fees, Buy Shipping label purchases
definitions.advertising.total: Sponsored Products invoices charged to the seller account, by posted date (not ad spend by day)
definitions.reimbursements.total: FBA Inventory Reimbursement lines incl. customer-return reimbursements and reversals
definitions.activity: sum of every economic line in the month = net_product_sales + amazon_fees.total + advertising.total + reimbursements.total + tax collected + tax remitted
definitions.owed_by_amazon_at_month_end.open_settlem: all money Amazon had posted to the seller by the end of the month that had not reached the seller's bank, minus reserve_held: open-settlement lines, DD+7 deferred orders, closed settlements whose deposit was in transit or failed, negative carried balances
definitions.owed_by_amazon_at_month_end.reserve_held: the 'Current Reserve Amount' of the last settlement closed before the month end
definitions.not_economic: Previous Reserve Amount Balance, Current Reserve Amount, Payable to Amazon, Failed disbursement and Transfer lines move money inside Amazon or to the bank; they are never activity

failed.reason: ACH return R02 (account closed): seller closed bank account ending 4417 on 2026-08-14 before updating Seller Central
